en.title: Herzog accepts certified Israeli election results; commission finds no fraud
en.dek: President Isaac Herzog accepted certified results after the Central Elections Committee audited 9,069 polling stations and found no evidence of fraud.
facts: President Isaac Herzog accepted the certified election results on 4 November, according to AP News and The Hindu.
The Central Elections Committee audited 9,069 polling stations after complaints and said it was confident the announced results reflected voters' will.
The election commission found no evidence of fraud in the 27 October vote, according to Euronews, Haaretz and ABC Australia.
Netanyahu accused Arab-led parties of stealing the election, according to ABC Australia and Dawn.
Netanyahu's allies refused to back the certified results, according to Al Jazeera, Bloomberg and JNS.
Neither Netanyahu nor Gadi Eisenkot had enough votes alone to form a government, according to The Straits Times.
body: President Isaac Herzog accepted the certified results of Israel's election on 4 November, according to AP News, The Hindu and NBC News. His acceptance followed the Central Elections Committee's certification of the vote.

The Central Elections Committee said it audited 9,069 polling stations after receiving complaints, and it was confident the announced results accurately reflected voters' will, according to The Hindu. The Guardian and Al Jazeera reported that the commission confirmed the vote results.

On 4 November, the election commission found no evidence of fraud in the 27 October vote, according to Euronews, Haaretz and ABC Australia. Haaretz said the finding came amid claims made by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and The Straits Times reported that the commission rejected those charges.

Netanyahu accused Arab-led parties of stealing the election, according to ABC Australia, and Dawn reported that he promoted allegations of fraud by Arab parties. The claims were not supported by the commission's findings.

Al Jazeera reported that Netanyahu's allies refused to back the certified results, while Bloomberg reported that he continued to reject the outcome. JNS reported that he and Likud reacted as the results were certified.

Neither major bloc earned a parliamentary majority in the vote, ABC Australia reported, and The Straits Times reported that neither Netanyahu nor Gadi Eisenkot had enough votes alone to form a government.

Netanyahu and Eisenkot began talks on forming a government after the 27 October election, according to Organiser and The Jerusalem Post. Organiser reported that presidential talks had started, and The Jerusalem Post followed both sides in live coverage.

Fox News reported that Herzog was deciding who would receive the mandate to form Israel's next government as rival camps sought a coalition, and The Hindu reported that he held the keys to forming the next government.
en.context: Israel held its election on 27 October 2026, and neither of the two main blocs won a parliamentary majority, according to ABC Australia. President Isaac Herzog was choosing which candidate would receive the mandate to form the next government, according to Fox News and The Hindu.

es.headline: Herzog acepta los resultados certificados de las elecciones de Israel
es.body: El presidente Isaac Herzog aceptó los resultados certificados de las elecciones de Israel, según AP News, The Hindu y NBC News. AP News informó de que la aceptación se produjo tras la certificación de la votación por el Comité Central Electoral.

de.headline: Herzog akzeptiert die beglaubigten Wahlergebnisse in Israel
de.body: Präsident Isaac Herzog hat die beglaubigten Ergebnisse der israelischen Wahl angenommen, wie AP News, The Hindu und NBC News berichteten. AP News berichtete, dass die Annahme auf die Beglaubigung des Wahlergebnisses durch den Zentralen Wahlausschuss folgte.

it.headline: Herzog accetta i risultati certificati delle elezioni in Israele
it.body: Il presidente Isaac Herzog ha accettato i risultati certificati delle elezioni in Israele, secondo AP News, The Hindu e NBC News. AP News ha riferito che l'accettazione è seguita alla certificazione del voto da parte della Commissione elettorale centrale.

fr.headline: Herzog accepte les résultats certifiés de l'élection en Israël
fr.body: Le président Isaac Herzog a accepté les résultats certifiés de l'élection en Israël, selon AP News, The Hindu et NBC News. AP News a indiqué que cette acceptation faisait suite à la certification du vote par la Commission centrale des élections.

pt.headline: Herzog aceita os resultados certificados da eleição em Israel
pt.body: O presidente Isaac Herzog aceitou os resultados certificados da eleição em Israel, de acordo com a AP News, o The Hindu e a NBC News. A AP News informou que a aceitação se seguiu à certificação do voto pela Comissão Central de Eleições.

en.headline: Election commission audited 9,069 polling stations in Israel
en.body: The Central Elections Committee said it audited 9,069 polling stations after complaints and was confident the announced results accurately reflected voters' will, according to The Hindu. The Guardian and Al Jazeera reported that the commission confirmed the vote results.

es.headline: La comisión electoral auditó 9.069 puntos de votación en Israel
es.body: El Comité Central Electoral afirmó que auditó 9.069 puntos de votación tras las quejas y estaba seguro de que los resultados anunciados reflejaban con exactitud la voluntad de los votantes, según The Hindu. The Guardian y Al Jazeera informaron de que la comisión confirmó los resultados de la votación.

de.headline: Wahlkommission überprüfte 9.069 Wahllokale in Israel
de.body: Der Zentrale Wahlausschuss erklärte, er habe nach Beschwerden 9.069 Wahllokale überprüft und sei zuversichtlich, dass die verkündeten Ergebnisse den Wählerwillen genau widerspiegelten, so The Hindu. The Guardian und Al Jazeera berichteten, dass die Kommission die Wahlergebnisse bestätigte.

it.headline: La commissione elettorale ha verificato 9.069 seggi elettorali in Israele
it.body: La Commissione elettorale centrale ha dichiarato di aver verificato 9.069 seggi elettorali in seguito alle lamentele e di essere convinta che i risultati annunciati riflettessero accuratamente la volontà degli elettori, secondo The Hindu. The Guardian e Al Jazeera hanno riferito che la commissione ha confermato i risultati del voto.

fr.headline: La commission électorale a audité 9 069 bureaux de vote en Israël
fr.body: La Commission centrale des élections a déclaré avoir audité 9 069 bureaux de vote après des plaintes et être confiante dans le fait que les résultats annoncés reflétaient fidèlement la volonté des électeurs, selon The Hindu. The Guardian et Al Jazeera ont rapporté que la commission a confirmé les résultats du vote.

pt.headline: Comissão eleitoral auditou 9 069 postos de votação em Israel
pt.body: A Comissão Central de Eleições informou que auditou 9 069 postos de votação após receber reclamações e estava confiante de que os resultados anunciados refletiam com precisão a vontade dos eleitores, de acordo com o The Hindu. O The Guardian e a Al Jazeera relataram que a comissão confirmou os resultados da votação.

de.headline: Netanjus Verbündete weigern sich, die beglaubigten Ergebnisse zu unterstützen

it.headline: Gli alleati di Netanyahu rifiutano di sostenere i risultati certificati
it.body: Gli alleati del primo ministro Benjamin Netanyahu si sono rifiutati di sostenere i risultati certificati delle elezioni, secondo Al Jazeera. Bloomberg ha riferito che Netanyahu ha continuato a rifiutare l'esito, mentre JNS ha riferito che lui e Likud hanno reagito mentre i risultati venivano certificati.

fr.headline: Les alliés de Netanyahou refusent de soutenir les résultats certifiés
fr.body: Les alliés du Premier ministre Benjamin Netanyahou ont refusé de soutenir les résultats certifiés de l'élection, selon Al Jazeera. Bloomberg a rapporté que Netanyahou continuait de rejeter le résultat, et JNS a rapporté que lui et le Likoud ont réagi à la certification des résultats.
